chunks: And Dāwūd ibn al-Ḥuṣayn narrated from Abū al-ʿAbbās, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله performed iʿtikāf in the month of Ramaḍān in the first ten days, then he performed iʿtikāf in the second, in the middle ten days, then he performed iʿtikāf in the third, in the last ten days. Then the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله continued to perform iʿtikāf in the last ten days.

key_terms.اعْتَكَفَ: performed iʿtikāf, meaning to seclude oneself in worship
key_terms.الْعَشْرِ الْأَوَاخِرِ: the last ten days of the month
key_terms.الْعَشْرِ الْأُولَى: the first ten days of the month
key_terms.الْعَشْرِ الْوُسْطَى: the middle ten days of the month
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramaḍān, the sacred month of fasting

ai.seo_question: In which part of Ramaḍān did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله perform iʿtikāf?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله regarding iʿtikāf in Ramaḍān. It shows that he performed it in different ten-day periods and then continued regularly in the last ten days, indicating the special significance of that period.
